wrapper.normalized_text:
#!/bin/sh
export CONDA_PREFIX='<INSTALL_PREFIX>'
export CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV='<INSTALL_PREFIX>'
export CONDA_SHLVL=1
export PATH="$CONDA_PREFIX/bin${PATH:+:$PATH}"
for _mise_conda_script in "$CONDA_PREFIX"/etc/conda/activate.d/*.sh; do
	if [ -f "$_mise_conda_script" ]; then
		. "$_mise_conda_script" || exit $?
	fi
done
unset _mise_conda_script
exec '<INSTALL_PREFIX>/bin/postgres' "$@"

Fresh means an empty isolated HOME (no mise installs or downloads), not an empty network cache upstream.
